# pdf-mcp — Full LLM Reference

Full-stack PDF intelligence MCP server. Extract, manipulate, annotate, convert, validate, and RAG-search PDFs.

## Quick Start

```bash
uv sync
cp .env.example .env
# Start backend
uv run python run_server.py --mode http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11131
# Start frontend (separate terminal)
cd webapp && bun install && bun run dev
```

## MCP Tool Reference

### pdf_extract

Extract content and metadata from PDFs.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `text` | path, pages (optional page range) | `{text, pages, page_count}` |
| `images` | path, pages | `{images: [{page, index, width, height, path, ext}]}` |
| `tables` | path, pages | `{tables: [{page, rows, cols, headers, data}]}` |
| `metadata` | path | `{metadata: {title, author, subject, page_count, file_size, ...}}` |
| `fonts` | path | `{fonts: [{name, type, encoding, embedded, size}]}` |
| `links` | path | `{links: [{page, uri, page_target, rect}]}` |
| `outline` | path | `{outline: [{title, level, page, children}]}` |

### pdf_manipulate

Modify PDF structure and properties.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `merge` | path (unused), paths (list of PDF paths) | `{path, pages}` |
| `split` | path, output_dir, ranges (optional page ranges) | `{files: [path, ...]}` |
| `rotate` | path, pages (range), angle (default 90) | `{path}` |
| `reorder` | path, new_order (1-indexed list) | `{path}` |
| `delete_pages` | path, page_list (1-indexed) | `{path}` |
| `compress` | path, quality (1-100, default 85) | `{path, original_size, compressed_size}` |
| `encrypt` | path, password | `{path}` |
| `decrypt` | path, password | `{path}` |
| `optimize` | path | `{path, original_size, optimized_size}` |

### pdf_annotate

Add annotations and markup to PDFs.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `watermark` | path, text or image_path, opacity (0.3), position | `{path}` |
| `stamp` | path, text, x, y | `{path}` |
| `highlight` | path, search_text, color (#FFFF00) | `{path, occurrences}` |
| `underline` | path, search_text | `{path, occurrences}` |
| `header_footer` | path, header, footer, font_size | `{path}` |
| `page_numbers` | path, start, position, font_size | `{path}` |

### pdf_forms

Handle interactive form fields.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `list_fields` | path | `{fields: [{name, type, value, page, rect}]}` |
| `fill` | path, fields ({name: value}) | `{path, filled}` |
| `flatten` | path | `{path}` |
| `export_data` | path | `{data: {field_name: value}}` |

### pdf_convert

Convert between PDF and other formats.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `to_markdown` | path | `{markdown, pages}` |
| `to_images` | path, fmt (png/jpeg), dpi (200) | `{images: [{page, path}]}` |
| `to_html` | path | `{html}` |
| `from_html` | html | `{path, pages}` |
| `from_markdown` | markdown | `{path, pages}` |
| `from_images` | paths (image file paths) | `{path, pages}` |

### pdf_validate

Audit PDF quality and compliance.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `pdfa` | path | `{is_pdfa, details}` |
| `structure` | path | `{has_tags, headings, paragraphs, issues}` |
| `accessibility` | path | `{score (0-100), issues}` |
| `integrity` | path | `{intact, pages_readable, warnings}` |
| `compare` | path (unused), path_a, path_b | `{same_page_count, text_similarity, diffs}` |

### pdf_rag

Build and query a RAG index over PDF content. Tables are indexed as structured
chunks (`section: "table"`); results carry `source_file` and `page_num` for
citation jumps.

| Operation | Parameters | Returns |
|-----------|-----------|---------|
| `chunk` | path, strategy (recursive/fixed), chunk_size (1000), overlap (200) | `{chunks, doc_id}` |
| `index` | path, strategy, chunk_size, overlap | `{chunks_indexed, doc_id}` |
| `search` | query, limit (10) | `{results: [{doc_id, chunk_id, page_num, section, source_file, text, _distance}]}` |
| `similar` | text (query-by-example snippet), limit | `{results: [...]}` same shape as search |
| `synthesize` | query, limit | `{groups: [{doc_id, source_file, hits, snippets}], summary?, llm}` |
| `list_documents` | (none) | `{documents: [{doc_id, chunk_count}]}` |
| `delete_index` | doc_id | `{success}` |

### pdf_analyze

Detect scanned vs digital PDFs with layout stats.

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| path | `{has_text_layer, scanned, pages, chars_per_page, total_chars, image_count, layout_hint, per_page}` |

### pdf_redact

Blacken sensitive content by terms and/or PII patterns (email, phone, IBAN, card, SSN, IP).

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| path, terms?, pii?, output_path? | `{path, occurrences}` |

### pdf_classify

Guess the document type (invoice, receipt, report, contract, form, resume,
presentation, letter, scanned-document, other) with candidate field extraction.

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| path, refine? | `{doc_type, confidence, fields, reasons, llm_refined}` |

### pdf_dedupe

Detect exact and near-duplicate PDFs by content fingerprint.

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| paths, threshold (0.85) | `{files, exact_duplicates, near_duplicates}` |

### pdf_export

Build a reusable document brief (markdown or JSON) with headings, key terms, optional LLM summary.

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| path, format (markdown/json), include_summary | `{path, pages, summary}` |

### pdf_do

Chain the PDF tools autonomously from a natural-language task (requires a local LLM).

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| task, path | `{answer, steps: [{tool, args, result}]}` |

### pdf_forms — auto_fill

LLM-guided form filling: extract field labels, map values from a source PDF/text, fill and save.

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| path, source (PDF) or text | `{path, filled, missing}` |

### pdf_annotate — summary_box

LLM summarizes the document and stamps the summary onto page 1.

| Parameter | Returns |
|-----------|---------|
| path | `{path, summary}` |

### Meta tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `pdf_help` | List tools, or get input schema for one tool |
| `pdf_status` | Server status, version, uptime, tool count, mode |
| `pdf_shutdown` | Gracefully stop the server |

## Architecture

```
pdf_mcp/
├── server.py          FastMCP app + Starlette HTTP app + REST endpoints
│                      (recipes, watch-folder, share links, usage stats)
├── config.py          Env-based configuration
├── models.py          Pydantic models + operation literals
├── tools/             10 tool modules
│   ├── extract.py     pdf_extract
│   ├── manipulate.py  pdf_manipulate
│   ├── annotate.py    pdf_annotate (incl. summary_box)
│   ├── forms.py       pdf_forms (incl. auto_fill)
│   ├── convert.py     pdf_convert
│   ├── validate.py    pdf_validate
│   ├── rag.py         pdf_rag (search / similar / synthesize)
│   ├── intel.py       pdf_analyze, pdf_redact, pdf_classify, pdf_dedupe, pdf_export
│   ├── agent.py       pdf_do (agentic chaining)
│   └── meta.py        pdf_help, pdf_status, pdf_shutdown
├── services/          Core engines
│   ├── extractor.py   PyMuPDF text/image/table/metadata extraction
│   ├── manipulator.py pypdf merge/split/rotate/compress/encrypt
│   ├── converter.py   PDF to/from Markdown/HTML/images
│   ├── chunker.py     Text chunking (recursive, fixed, table-aware)
│   ├── rag_store.py   LanceDB vector store wrapper
│   ├── intel.py       Analyzer, Redactor, Classifier, Deduper, BriefBuilder
│   └── llm.py         Local LLM discovery + chat completions
└── skills/
    └── pdf-expert/
        └── SKILL.md   Agent skill file

webapp/
├── src/
│   ├── App.tsx        Router with 7 lazy-loaded pages
│   ├── pages/         Dashboard, Workbench, Pipeline, Chat, Tools, Skills, Logs
│   └── lib/           api.ts (fetch layer) + store.ts (Zustand incl. LLM state)
├── e2e/               Playwright tests
├── vite.config.ts     Vite config with proxy (/api, /mcp -> :11131)
└── package.json
```

## Configuration

| Env Var | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `MCP_MODE` | stdio | Server mode: stdio or http |
| `MCP_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | HTTP bind host |
| `MCP_PORT` | 11131 | HTTP port |
| `FRONTEND_PORT` | 11130 | Frontend CORS origin |
| `RAG_EMBEDDING_URL` | (none) | OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint |
| `RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | all-MiniLM-L6-v2 | Embedding model name |
| `RAG_STORE_PATH` | data/lancedb | LanceDB storage path |
| `UPLOAD_DIR` | data/uploads | Upload directory |
| `PDF_MCP_TAURI` | (none) | Set to 1 when inside Tauri WebView |

## Webapp Pages

| Route | Page | Features |
|-------|------|----------|
| `/` | Dashboard | KPIs (health, tool count, uptime), LLM availability banner, usage stats panel, exponential backoff health poll |
| `/workbench` | Workbench | PDF.js canvas viewer, OCR (scanned/digital) badge, side-by-side compare mode, tool palette, live job execution with result download |
| `/pipeline` | Pipeline | Upload PDF, single operation or multi-step recipe, job history with share links |
| `/chat` | Chat | LLM chat with skill-first system prompt, personality + provider/model select, PDF search with source citations (jump-to-page), export/clear |
| `/tools` | Tools | Dynamic discovery via /api/tools, portmanteau drill-down, input schema rendering |
| `/skills` | Skills | Load and render SKILL.md from /api/skills/{name} (XSS-safe) |
| `/logs` | Logs | Real-time log viewer (ring buffer) |

## REST Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/health` | GET | Server health, version, uptime, tool count |
| `/api/v1/diagnostics` | GET | Tools list, system info, errors |
| `/api/tools` | GET | Tool list with input schemas |
| `/api/skills` | GET | Skill list |
| `/api/skills/{name}` | GET | Raw SKILL.md content |
| `/api/llm/discover` | GET | Ollama / LM Studio detection |
| `/api/chat` | POST | LLM chat completion |
| `/api/pdf/upload` | POST | Upload PDF (multipart) |
| `/api/pdf/files/{name}` | GET | Serve an uploaded file (for the viewer) |
| `/api/jobs` | GET/POST | List / create batch jobs |
| `/api/jobs/{job_id}` | GET | Job status and progress |
| `/api/pdf/{job_id}/result` | GET | Download job result file |
| `/api/logs` | GET | Ring-buffer log tail |
| `/api/recipes` | GET | Named pipeline recipes (ingest, redact_export, brief) |
| `/api/pdf/analyze` | GET | OCR readiness for an uploaded file |
| `/api/pdf/compare` | POST | Side-by-side text diff of two uploaded files |
| `/api/pdf/dedupe` | POST | Exact/near-duplicate check across uploaded files |
| `/api/rag/search` | POST | Synchronous RAG search (chat sources) |
| `/api/share/{job_id}` | POST | Create a 24 h share link for a completed job |
| `/api/share/{token}` | GET | Stream a shared result file |
| `/api/stats` | GET | Per-operation usage stats |
| `/api/watch/status` | GET | Watch-folder status |
| `/mcp` | POST | MCP streamable HTTP transport |

`POST /api/jobs` also accepts `{recipe: "ingest"|"redact_export"|"brief", params}` to run multi-step recipes.

## Ports

- Frontend: 11130 (Vite dev server)
- Backend: 11131 (Starlette + FastMCP HTTP)
